fields.description:
Consolidate the force-bypass surface across lib + CLI and remove the redundant `force_close` param. Operator ruling (2026-08-18): `force_close` is to be removed, and `--force` must NOT accept an inline reason — the audit note comes from the already-established separate `reason` parameter.

## Context / Problem
`rebar.transition` today exposes TWO overlapping bypass params: `force: bool` (bypasses the start-work / plan-review gate) and `force_close: str` (bypasses the completion-verification / signature CLOSE gate AND carries its audit reason inline). The CLI `--force[=<reason>]` maps to `force_close` on a close and to `force` on start-work, and also accepts an inline `=<reason>`. This is redundant and inconsistent: a single `force` boolean plus the existing separate `reason` param already express the same intent. (The CLI `--force-close` spelling was already retired as a clean break in 24f7; this ticket removes the remaining `force_close` PARAM and the `--force=<reason>` inline form.)

## Approach
Make `force: bool` the single gate-bypass across BOTH gates and route the audit note through the existing `reason: str` param; remove `force_close`.
- Rewire the completion-verification close seam (close_precheck.py `if force_close:` ~line 566; transition_close.py ~line 440 `if not force_close ...`) to key on `force` instead of `force_close`, recording `reason` as the force-close audit note.
- Remove the `force_close` param from `rebar.transition` (_lib_writes.py). Provide a migration alias via the sanctioned lib-kind deprecation registry (rebar._deprecations, `_KINDS` includes `lib`): a call passing `force_close="<r>"` WARNs and is mapped to `force=True, reason="<r>"`, scheduled for removal. (Not the `RemovedInput` tombstone, whose `_TOMBSTONE_KINDS` is env/cfg/file only.)
- CLI: `--force` becomes a bare boolean (drop the `--force=<reason>` inline form); the audit note is supplied by the existing `--reason=<text>`. Update the usage/help text in transition.py accordingly.
- Reducer/schema (reducer/_processors_status.py, schemas/ticket_state.schema.json, txn.py, types.py) are UNCHANGED for historical-event tolerance: this is an event-sourced store, so historical events carrying force_close MUST keep reducing to the same state — tombstone the INPUT, not the event.

## Scope
- src/rebar/_lib_writes.py — remove force_close param from transition(); map a legacy force_close call via _deprecations to force+reason.
- src/rebar/_commands/close_precheck.py — key the completion-verify close bypass on `force` (with `reason` audit note) instead of `force_close`.
- src/rebar/_commands/transition_close.py — same rewiring in the close-execution path + force-close audit comment.
- src/rebar/_commands/transition.py — `--force` bare bool only (drop inline `=<reason>`); reason via `--reason`; update usage/help.
- src/rebar/_deprecations.py — register the lib `force_close` kwarg deprecation alias.
- Reducer/schema — INTENTIONALLY UNCHANGED (back-compat).

## Testing
- Closing a work ticket under the completion-verification gate with `force=True, reason="x"` (lib) and `transition ... --force --reason=x` (CLI) bypasses the verifier/signature and records "x" as the force-close audit note — the same closed-without-signature outcome as before (test both surfaces).
- Passing `rebar.transition(..., force_close="x")` WARNs via _deprecations and behaves as `force=True, reason="x"` (unit test).
- The CLI `--force=<reason>` inline form is no longer accepted; bare `--force` + `--reason` is the path (interface test).
- A historical event carrying force_close still reduces to the identical ticket state (reducer fixture test).

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] `force=True` bypasses BOTH the start-work and completion-verification close gates, and `reason` supplies the force-close audit note (tests on lib + CLI).
- [ ] The `force_close` param is removed from `rebar.transition`; a legacy `force_close="<r>"` call WARNs via rebar._deprecations and maps to `force=True, reason="<r>"` (unit test).
- [ ] CLI `--force` no longer accepts an inline reason; the reason is supplied via `--reason` (interface test); usage/help updated.
- [ ] A historical event carrying force_close still reduces to the same ticket state (reducer fixture test passes).
- [ ] Docs/docstrings no longer present force_close as a live param or `--force=<reason>` as a supported form (grep is clean).
- [ ] `make lint` and `make typecheck` are green.
